name: EyeAssist
description: De-identified radiology eye-tracking resource comprising the EyeAssist-Neo neonatal-radiograph panel and EyeAssist-PE CTPA panel. Reader group, task, session, information state and held-out pool composition are analysis-critical metadata.
license: Access is governed by the conditions displayed in the gated dataset repository.

recordSet.name: EyeAssist-Neo gaze records
recordSet.description: Anonymous case-reader-session gaze records for 75 neonatal radiographs from 75 patients. The analysis panels comprise ten first-session readers and a three-reader repeated-session subset.

field.name: patient_id
field.description: Anonymous patient identifier; one-to-one with case_id in EyeAssist-Neo

field.name: x
field.description: Horizontal gaze coordinate on the case-specific image canvas

field.name: y
field.description: Vertical gaze coordinate on the case-specific image canvas

field.name: normal_abnormal
field.description: Status derived from the clinician-recorded diagnostic field: explicit NORMAL codes are normal and all other recorded diagnoses are abnormal

recordSet.name: EyeAssist-PE gaze records
recordSet.description: Anonymous case-reader-session gaze records for 40 CTPA volumes from 40 patients, seven readers and two reading sessions.

field.name: slice_index
field.description: CT slice displayed when gaze was recorded
